title: Signal: Prometheus metrics endpoint disclosed in a response
scope: One response whose body contains # HELP, # TYPE and a Go runtime series.
limitations: Three body markers. A page that documents the exposition format is not matched unless it reproduces the runtime series as well.

observation.body:
# HELP go_gc_duration_seconds A summary of the pause duration of garbage collection cycles.
# TYPE go_gc_duration_seconds summary
go_gc_duration_seconds{quantile="0"} 1e-05

# HELP process_cpu_seconds_total Total user and system CPU time spent in seconds.
# TYPE process_cpu_seconds_total counter
go_gc_duration_seconds_sum 0.03
# HELP and # TYPE lines start a metric family.

fpNotes: A metrics exposition from a non-Go exporter is not reported by this rule; that endpoint has its own identity markers.
